messages:
Maria Chen: heads up — nightly evals for rwd-v2 quant variants jumped on the summarization suite, ~12% failures vs ~1% baseline.
Eli Park: yikes. what failure mode are we seeing? hallucinations or cutoffs?
Maria Chen: mostly early truncation — model emits an EOS mid-sentence plus occasional literal "</s>" tokens in the body for q4f16 builds. not typical hallucination text.
Tanya Iqbal: can you post the nightly job id and exact model tag?
Maria Chen: job 2026-03-19-23:00, model rwd-v2-q4-opt-20260319, commit c2f4b9a. ai-eval-bot alerted: "[ALERT] summarization_suite fail rate 12.1% (threshold 3%)".
ai-eval-bot: Fri Mar 19 23:01:02 UTC — Regression detected: summarization_prompts (12.1% -> 1.3%). See /evaluations/2026-03-19-23:00
Jasper Li: any runtime/kernel changes in that commit? I recall an attention merge landed last week.
Samir Patel: c2f4b9a includes attn:merge_reorder tweak plus a tiny RNG refactor in kernel scheduling. cc: @eng-runtime.
Eli Park: my gut says a KV-cache index reordering could produce premature EOS for certain prefix lengths.
Tanya Iqbal: can we reproduce locally with the failing prompt set and quant flags? paste the exact repro command.
Maria Chen: repro I ran locally: 
```
./eval_runner --model rwd-v2-q4-opt-20260319 --suite summarization_prompts --batch 1 --seed 1234 --quant=q4f16 --max-tokens 256 --log-level debug
```
Maria Chen: failing trace excerpt (sanitized):
```
... decoding step 112: top token predicted: "</s>" (p=0.002) but gold continues; kv-index for layer 7 used idx=110 vs expected 111
... attention map appears shifted by one for prefix length 110
```
Samir Patel: that log is consistent with merge_reorder applying an index offset incorrectly when pos % block == 0.
Eli Park: quick checks: run pre-merge branch + full float + q8 to see quant interaction.
Jasper Li: also try deterministic sampling (top_k=1) to eliminate sampling noise.
Maria Chen: short results: pre-merge branch -> 1.2% fails; post-merge (c2f4b9a) q4f16 -> 12.1%; post-merge float32 -> 3.0%; post-merge q8 -> 2.8%.
Eli Park: float32 reduces but does not fully fix. quant amplifies the issue. sounds like an indexing bug magnified by low-precision rounding.
Tanya Iqbal: can we get a minimal failing prompt for a unit test?
Maria Chen: minimal anonymized prompt: "Summarize: The committee met for three hours to decide the grant. They reached consensus, but the final paragraph..." expected continuation, model returns "</s>" mid-sentence. added example to /internal/evals/failed_summaries/2026-03-19.json.
Samir Patel: plan: bisect kernel commits between 2026-03-12 and 2026-03-19, instrument kv-index calc to log prefix lengths, add tests for seq lengths around block boundaries (e.g., 64,128,192). assigning to eng-runtime.
Jasper Li: I'll run deterministic replays and disable streaming to rule out async scheduling.
Eli Park: I'll retest quantize pipeline with stochastic vs nearest rounding to gauge sensitivity.
ai-eval-bot: Test replay scheduled by @Jasper Li — replay job id 2026-03-20-01:12
Samir Patel: bisect found the culprit: in attn_merge() commit we introduced `start_idx = ((pos + 1) / block) * block` which rounds up instead of down. when pos % block == 0 this shifts kv index by one block. reproducible.
Tanya Iqbal: that explains truncation at exact-block prefix lengths. off-by-block bug combined with quantization error => early EOS.
Eli Park: proposed fix: use floor rounding: `start_idx = (pos / block) * block` and add unit tests for pos==block and pos==block-1.
Samir Patel: PR incoming (eng-runtime PR #4821) with fix + regression tests. also adding a nightly regression gate asserting summarization failrate <= 3% for rwd-v2-q4-opt.
Maria Chen: can we hotfix staging/prod? how many customers on q4f16?
Jasper Li: few customers in dedicated test clusters; hosted API still on fp16. but revert is safer until patch lands.
Samir Patel: revert PR #4822 merged to staging. replayed nightly -> summarization fail rate dropped to 1.4% on staging. patch ready to merge after reviews.
Maria Chen: creating followups: ML-788 to add fuzz-seq-length test & link to PRs.
Eli Park: let's also add a small fuzz test in pre-merge CI: sample ~200 sequence lengths from production prefix distribution with quant configs and quick decode.
Samir Patel: noted. final notes: root cause = attn_merge rounding-up off-by-block + quant rounding amplifying token-boundary errors. next steps: merge fix, add unit+fuzz tests, enforce nightly regression auto-issue creation.
Jasper Li: :thumbsup:
ai-eval-bot: Regression resolved on staging — monitoring for 24h.
